title: FracDSS
summary: FracDSS simulates distributed strain signals induced by fracture propagation, opening and closure, and shear slip. It provides a forward-modeling basis for interpreting distributed fiber-optic strain measurements.
image_alt: Synchronized FracDSS results showing three-dimensional planar fracture growth, a schematic horizontal treatment well, horizontal and vertical monitoring wells, and progressively revealed strain-rate waterfalls from the two supplied cases.

title: FracQC
summary: FracQC quantitatively characterizes hydraulic-fracture geometry from field distributed strain measurements. It estimates fracture half-length before well intersection and fracture width and height after intersection, using data from vertical and horizontal monitoring wells.
image_alt: Time-synchronized FracQC field example: a gold cursor scans vertical-well monitoring data, horizontal offset-well data and pumping curves; the results show fracture half-length before fracture hit, then fracture width and height from both monitoring wells after fracture hit.

title: GeoFTSim+
summary: GeoFTSim+ simulates oil, gas, and water flow in deformable fractured porous media. We continuously develop the code to expand its modeling capabilities and broaden its applications in subsurface reservoirs.
image_alt: Illustrative three-dimensional reservoir pressure-depletion model. Three sets of prescribed vertical fractures form U, P and C in plan view; declining pressure gradually reveals the letters as production proceeds.
